app.name: Penny proxy votes
app.short_description: Record a customer's vote with its Zendesk ticket source.
app.long_description: Search published Penny requests and explicitly record a proxy vote for an existing customer or a new unverified contact.
app.installation_instructions: Use your Penny HTTPS origin, the same hostname without a scheme, and a scoped Penny API key. See README.md.

penny_host.label: Penny allowed hostname
penny_host.helpText: The same hostname without https://, for example feedback.example.com.

penny_api_key.label: Penny API key
penny_api_key.helpText: Requires requests:read and votes:write. Zendesk stores this as a secure setting.
